integrity: All formulas are supported by an explicit four-case root classification and local word enumeration, with a reproducible finite verifier. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Exact unweighted count for cycles with two or more vertex-disjoint pendant paths attached at a single root; not a result for arbitrary unicyclic graphs, multiroot attachments, or edge-size generating polynomials. The finite tests are corroboration, not a proof or independent validation.
title: Perfect-edge-domination enumeration on arbitrary one-hub cycle spiders
